bio.text: Kate Farrar was first elected in November 2020 to represent the 20th House District, which includes parts of West Hartford and Newington, and serves as Deputy Majority Leader.

She previously was Executive Director of the Connecticut Women's Education and Legal Fund and Vice President of Campus Leadership Programs at the American Association of University Women in Washington, D.C.
She earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Connecticut and a master's in public administration from Syracuse University, and lives in West Hartford.
